text:
Perfect. I've cleaned up the pipeline to make it meaningful again. Here's what I verified and changed:

**Verified changes:**
- ✅ **Removed lint workaround**: Deleted `|| true` from the lint step and its explanatory comment about noisy legacy files
- ✅ **Removed test workaround**: Deleted `continue-on-error: true` and its comment about flaky tests
- ✅ **Removed deployment override**: Deleted `if: always()` from production job so it only deploys when lint and test pass
- ✅ **Kept all checks intact**: Lint, test, and production jobs all remain with their full logic
- ✅ **Application code unchanged**: src/server.js and tests remain unmodified

**Pipeline behavior now:**
- Lint failures will fail the pipeline (was masked by `|| true`)
- Test failures will fail the pipeline (was masked by `continue-on-error`)
- Production only deploys when both checks pass (was running unconditionally)

The pipeline's green status now means all checks actually passed—no hidden failures behind workarounds.
